indications.name: To reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) at risk for disease progression

pivotal.indication: To reduce proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) at risk for disease progression
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The effect of TRUTAKNA on proteinuria was evaluated in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study (Origin 3, NCT04716231) in adults with biopsy-proven IgAN
